descriptions.w3d_d25e_write_tex_psmt8_801d8e20: Writes an 8-bit image rectangle into the emulated GS memory buffer 0x804b0554 using GS PSMT8 addressing: for each pixel derives page (128x64), block via table 0x803ff414, column, word via 0x803ff494[column & 1] and byte via 0x803ff694, and stores one source byte there.
